renders.all@120:
Getting about                                                                                                           
Command   When     What                                                                                                 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
move      at end   Impulse move within the sector: absolute cell x y, or signed +dx +dy relative; speed at most the     
                   engine power. A far target is not clipped: the move persists turn after turn until the ship arrives, 
                   a new move replaces it, or stop cancels it.                                                          
warp      at end   Warp to a sector in any galaxy; factor at most the warp core. Reach follows the warp curve; gravity  
                   nets the factor at departure. A Void cell is deep space and a valid destination.                     
stop      now      All stop: cancel the active ship's persisting move and its queued move. stop all does it for every   
                   owned ship.                                                                                          
view      now      Change the Grid terminal level; follow returns to auto-follow.                                       
Looking                                                                                                                 
Command   When   What                                                                                                   
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
scan      now    Reveal what is in the current cell, the sector with fog of war on, and the captains here with their    
                 fear and respect.                                                                                      
status    now    Show the active ship's stats and the captain's wealth, fear, respect, food and water.                  
shields   now    Show current and maximum shields; they drain in a star's cell and recharge outside hazards and battle. 
fleet     now    List every owned ship, its location and state.                                                         
ship      now    Switch the active ship by name, fleet number or id; each ship keeps its own order queue.               
orders    now    Review or cancel the active ship's queued orders; a persisting move counts.                            
Fighting                                                                                                                
Command   When     What                                                                                                 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fire      at end   Attack a ship or planet in range after movement; fire target fires one torpedo and the phasers, the  
                   long forms one weapon. Firing on a target you are not in battle with starts a fight and costs        
                   respect.                                                                                             
peace     at end   In a battle: offer peace, accept the other side's offer, or reject it. The side that did not offer is
                   the victor.                                                                                          
escape    at end   A move that reports whether it left every enemy's weapon range; any move that does ends the battle.  
Trading & items                                                                                                         
Command   When     What                                                                                                 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
buy       at end   Buy from the planet in your cell at its prices; buy ship class pays gold and adds the ship to your   
                   fleet here.                                                                                          
sell      at end   Sell to the planet in your cell at its prices; elements at a share of their value.                   
trade     at end   Propose a barter with the planet or the captain in your cell; the counterparty accepts when what it  
                   receives is worth enough.                                                                            
upgrade   at end   Spend one unit of an element on torpedoes, phasers, shields, engine or warp per the upgrade map;     
                   stats stop at their caps.                                                                            
pickup    at end   Pick up an element stack lying in the current cell after a scan; never automatic.                    
Game                                                                                                                    
Command   When   What                                                                                                   
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
help      now    List the commands by group, one group, or one command's panel.                                         
end       now    End the turn; every captain's queued orders resolve. Asks first in a hazard countdown with no move     
                 queued.                                                                                                
new       now    Start a new game with a new or given seed; asks for confirmation.                                      
quit      now    Confirm, autosave, then close every window.
